The '''Eternal Alliance fleet''', also known as the '''Alliance fleet''', was the [[Navy/Legends|navy]] of the [[Eternal Alliance]], an organization originally created to stop the [[Eternal Empire]]. Led by the [[Alliance Commander]], the fleet was formed from former [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] and [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Starship/Legends|starships]], alongside the Alliance [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] the ''[[Gravestone]]''.

Following the defeat of the [[Eternal Empire]] and the Alliance reorganization into the the Eternal Alliance, the navy absorbed the [[Eternal Fleet]], which made the Eternal Alliance being considered one of the most powerful factions in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Following the destruction of the Eternal Fleet and the ''Gravestone'' by the [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] [[Zildrog]], the navy strength was reduced, but still boasted several Imperial and Republic ships.

Once the Commander decided to join the Galactic Republic, the Eternal Alliance fleet started to coordinate with [[Task Force Nova]].

==Organization==
The Eternal Alliance fleet<ref name="Codex State" /> was overseen by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Bey'wan Aygo]] and the [[Military Operations]] division, but was under direct control of the Alliance Commander at all [[Time/Legends|times]]. The fleet headquarters were located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Odessen]].<ref name="KOTFE Chapter 9" />

==History==
===Fighting the Eternal Empire===
In [[3631 BBY]],<ref name="Date 4.0 /> when the Alliance was formed on the planet Odessen, the fleet mainly consisted of the ''[[Gravestone]]'', the Alliance [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] that had been found in the [[Endless Swamp]] on the planet [[Zakuul]], and a contingent of former Imperial [[Mark VI Supremacy-class starfighter|Mark VI ''Supremacy''-class]] and Republic [[Liberator-class starfighter|''Liberator''-class]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]].<ref name="KOTFE Chapter 9" />

[[File:AllianceFleet-KOTFE.png|thumb|left|250px|Imperial and Republic forces joined the Eternal Alliance after the Battle of Odessen.]]
Following the [[Battle of Odessen|first Battle of Odessen]],<ref name="KOTFE Chapter 16" /> in [[3630 BBY]],<ref name="Date 4.7">{{TOR_updates|4.7}}</ref> the [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] increased its size by adding multiple [[Thranta-class corvette|''Thranta''-class corvettes]], [[Terminus-class destroyer|''Terminus''-class destroyers]], [[Unidentified warship class (Sith Empire)|Sith Empire warships]], and [[Unidentified Republic transport|Republic transports]].<ref name="KOTFE Chapter 16">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|chapter=16}}</ref> During the [[war against Zakuul]], the Alliance utilized several [[Eternal Empire shuttle]]s to disguise themselves from the [[Eternal Empire]].<ref name="KOTET Chapter 1" />

[[File:Invasion_Voss.png|thumb|right|250px|The Alliance fleet faced the Eternal Fleet on Voss]]
The fleet saw action throughout the year in several battles such as the [[Invasion of Voss|defense]] of [[Voss]], where several ships confronted the Eternal Fleet and draw away the Eternal Fleet attention from [[Voss]]' surface. The defense of Voss would ultimately be successful after the Sith Empire [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Navy]] decided to join forces with the Alliance.<ref name="KOTET Chapter 1" /> The fleet once again faced the Eternal Fleet when it [[Assault on the Gravestone|attacked]] the ''Gravestone'', where the battle ended up being inconclusive after [[SCORPIO]], the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] advisor of Empress [[Vaylin]], took the ''Gravestone'' to travel to the planet [[Iokath]].<ref name="KOTET Chapter 3" />

When Vaylin [[Assault on Odessen|attacked]] Odessen, the fleet composed of ''Thranta''-class and ''Terminus''-class starships defended the [[Alliance base]] from the Eternal Fleet. Following Vaylin's death, the Eternal Fleet jumped away from Odessen marking a victory for the Alliance.<ref name="KOTET Chapter 8">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|chapter=8}}</ref> When the Alliance learned that the Eternal Fleet was activating their original programming and attacking several world including [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] and Zakuul, the [[Alliance Commander]] took the fleet to Zakuul so they could take the [[Eternal Throne]] and stop the Eternal Fleet from continuing their rampage. The fleet began their [[Battle of Zakuul|attack]] while the Commander alongside [[Senya Tirall]] and [[Arcann]] made their way to the throne. Eventually, after deafeating [[Tenebrae|Valkorion]] the Commander took control of the throne and pacified the Eternal Fleet, ending the war against Zakuul.<ref name="KOTET Chapter 9" />

===The Eternal Alliance===
[[File:EternalAllianceFleetIokath-KOTET.png|thumb|left|250px|The Eternal Fleet joined the Commander on Iokath.]]
After the Battle of Zakuul, the Alliance reorganized itself to the Eternal Alliance, with this reorganization the Alliance Commander also integrated the [[Eternal Fleet]], an armada composed of hundreds of [[Eternal Fleet warship|warships]], to the Eternal Alliance fleet. With the Eternal Fleet in the navy, the Eternal Alliance became one of the most powerful factions in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="KOTET Chapter 9" /> The fleet also had at least one [[Hym Jemuro's capital ship|capital ship]] under the command of [[Hym Jemuro]].<ref name="Zakuulan Allies" />

In [[3629 BBY]],<ref name="Date 5.2>{{TOR_updates|5.2}}</ref> the Alliance Commander learned that both the Sith Empire and the Galactic Republic were on Iokath looking for a [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]], the Alliance dispatched the Eternal Fleet to Iokath in an attempt to stop them from getting the weapon. Unknown to the Commander a signal from Iokath's surface blocked communications between the Throne and the Eternal Fleet, leaving the Eternal Fleet dormant above Iokath. On the surface, the Commander allied with the Galactic Republic and tried to stop Empress [[Darth Acina]] from activating the superweapon, but a power surge killed Acina and deactivated the signal blocking the Eternal Fleet, bringing it back online. The fleet would eventually fire against [[Tyth]], one of the [[Six Gods]] that had been awakened as a result of the power surge.<ref name="Forgotten">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=general|The Forgotten World|Iokath}}</ref>

[[File:ZildrogCampaign.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Zildrog destroyed both the ''Gravestone'' and the Eternal Fleet.]]
In [[3628 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|5.9}}</ref> following the [[Mission to Nathema (Zildrog)|Mission to Nathema]], the Eternal Alliance fleet strength was diminished after the ancient superweapon [[Zildrog]] destroyed the Eternal Fleet and the ''Gravestone'',<ref name="Nathema">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=flashpoint|The Nathema Conspiracy}}</ref> as a consequence to the Eternal Alliance military almost being destroyed, the Galactic Republic and Sith Empire redoubled their efforts to prepare for war. Although the Alliance lost most of its ships it didn't stop their operations, and a small fleet continued their duty by patrolling the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]].<ref name="Codex State" />

===New Galactic Conflict===
In [[3628 BBY]],<ref name="TOR 5.10">{{TOR_updates|5.10.0}}</ref> when the [[Third Galactic War|war]] between the Sith Empire and the Galactic Republic resumed after the [[Invasion of Ossus]], the Eternal Alliance allied themselves with the Republic. In preparation for type of attack on Odessen, Admiral Aygo positioned the Eternal Alliance fleet in defensive positions around the planet.<ref name="Hearts and Minds">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=faction|[[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]|Hearts and Minds|[[Odessen]]}}</ref>

[[File:EternalAllianceFleetCorellia-Onslaught.png|thumb|left|250px|The Eternal Alliance fleet participated in the Meridian Complex defense.]]
In [[3627 BBY]],<ref name="Date 6.0">{{TOR_updates|6.0}}</ref> the Republic learned that [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] and the [[Meridian Complex]] was going to be attacked by the Sith Empire, the Republic began scrambling any available Republic fleets to defend the planet. With the help of the Eternal Alliance the [[Eleventh Fleet (Galactic Republic)|Eleventh Fleet]] and the [[Twenty-Ninth Fleet]] managed to refuel at [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] and [[Mek-Sha]], before joining Corellia's defenses.<ref name="Onslaught">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught]]''</ref> Before the [[Battle of the Meridian Complex]] began, both the Republic and the Eternal Alliance had a briefing to prepare for the battle, [[Fleet Admiral/Legends|Fleet Admiral]] [[Numinn]] of the Republic Navy suggested that the Eternal Alliance fleet should hide near the planet [[Talus/Legends|Talus]], and then hyperjump to the battle once they knew their objective. When the Commander arrived to the battle the Sith Empire fleet had already began their attack, two groups under Malgus' command composed of [[Silencer (superweapon)|Silencer]] dreadnoughts and [[isotope-5]] vessels were attacking the Republic fleet head on and another group commanded by [[Darth Krovos]] was positioned on the far side of Corellia. The original plan for the Eternal Alliance fleet was to attack the Silencers. When Krovos' group started an [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|orbital bombardment]] of the planet surface targeting residential and industrial areas, the Commander sent Admiral Aygo and the Eternal Alliance fleet after them in an attempt to stop the bombardment.<ref name="Objective Meridian" />

Following a battle both in space and on the ground the attack on the Meridian Complex was foiled by the Republic and the Alliance. At [[Carrick Station]], the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Galena Rans]] offered the Commander the opportunity to join the Republic, with Odessen as their member world with a [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]] representative, and the opportunity to lead [[Task Force Nova]], a join military-civilian initiative tasked with the rebuilding of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. The Commander accepted the offer after some consideration, and the Alliance joined the Galactic Republic.<ref name="Objective Meridian" /> Admiral Aygo considered the joint operations to be the most activity Military Operations had seen.<ref name="Aygo Mail">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=message|Military Operations Update|Bey'wan Aygo}}</ref>

==Equipment==
===Starships===
[[File:StarfightersOdessen-KOTFE.png|thumb|right|250px|The Eternal Alliance counted with former Imperial and Republic starfighters.]]
The Eternal Alliance fleet was mainly composed of former Imperial and Republic starships. The main ship of the Eternal Alliance was the ''[[Gravestone]]'', which served as the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of the Alliance,<ref name="KOTFE Chapter 16" /> until its destruction.<ref name="Nathema" /> Following the [[Battle of Odessen]], the fleet counted with several [[Thranta-class corvette|''Thranta''-class corvettes]], [[Terminus-class destroyer|''Terminus''-class destroyers]], [[Unidentified warship class (Sith Empire)|Sith Empire warships]] and [[Unidentified Republic transport|Republic transports]].<ref name="KOTFE Chapter 16" />

The Eternal Alliance also had a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] component mainly comprised of [[Mark VI Supremacy-class starfighter|Mark VI ''Supremacy''-class starfighters]] and [[Liberator-class starfighter|''Liberator''-class starfighters]].<ref name="KOTFE Chapter 9" />

Throught the [[War against Zakuul]], the Eternal Alliance also utilized several [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttles]] and [[Transport/Legends|transports]] to move personnel,<ref name="KOTFE Chapter 16" /> resources or for infiltration. The [[Eternal Empire shuttle]],<ref name="KOTET Chapter 1" /> the [[Plug-6 heavy fighter]] and the [[Fortitude-class assault shuttle|''Fortitude''-class assault shuttle]] were often used by the Alliance.<ref name="KOTFE Chapter 16" />

After the war with Zakuul the Eternal Alliance fleet counted with hundreds of [[Eternal Fleet warship]]s, which were controlled by the [[Eternal Throne]] and [[GEMINI]] droids,<ref name="KOTET Chapter 9" /> until their destruction by Zildrog.<ref name="Nathema" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Eternal Alliance fleet first appeared in the [[2015]] digital expansion [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire|''Knights of the Fallen Empire'']] for [[BioWare]]'s [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="SWTOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]''</ref>

===Gameplay alternatives===
If the player's original faction is the Republic, during the Flashpoint ''Objective Meridian'' the Commander can decide whether to stop Darth Krovos' orbital bombardment of Corellia for Light Side points or to stick to the plan and engage in battle with the Sith Empire Silencers for Dark Side points. The article assumes the Commander chose the Light Side option. If the player's original faction is the Sith Empire, the fleet will be requested to escort the Silencers.<ref name="Objective Meridian" />
